about.title: About
about.name: Edgar Alan Zanin
about.bio1: From Triathlete to Fitness Coach, I live and breathe sports in the south of England. My passion for running quickly led me to the world of endurance racing, starting with completing a challenging Ironman 70.3 and a Full Ironman.
about.bio2: This journey has given me the practical experience and technical knowledge to know what it takes to achieve goals that, today, may seem unattainable. My commitment? To combine the discipline of an Ironman with the science of fitness so that you can achieve your best physical and mental shape.
about.certificationHighlight: Edgar Zanin is a Level 3 Personal Trainer certified by YMCA Awards (UK), with in-depth training in anatomy, physiology, nutrition, safety, and exercise programming.

services.title: My
services.subtitle: Comprehensive fitness and performance training tailored to your individual goals and needs.

strength.title: Strength Training
strength.description: Customized strength programs for all fitness levels, focusing on proper form and progressive overload principles.

endurance.title: Endurance Coaching
endurance.description: Specialized training for runners, cyclists, and triathletes looking to improve endurance and race performance.

hiit.title: HIIT & Conditioning
hiit.description: High-intensity interval training sessions designed to maximize calorie burn and improve cardiovascular fitness.

race.title: Race Preparation
race.description: Comprehensive training plans for upcoming races, from 5Ks to marathon and triathlon events.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Fitness?
cta.description: I offer personalized 1-on-1 training both in-person in Bournemouth and online for clients worldwide. Each program is specially designed to fit your specific goals, fitness level, and schedule.

achievements.title: My
achievements.subtitle: Personal records and competitive accomplishments that demonstrate my dedication to fitness and endurance sports.

fullIronman.title: Full Ironman Finisher
fullIronman.description: Completed the ultimate endurance challenge - a full Ironman triathlon consisting of a 3.8 km swim, 180 km bike, and a full 42.2 km marathon run.

ironman.title: Ironman 70.3 Finisher
ironman.description: Completed the challenging half-distance Ironman triathlon, consisting of a 1.9 km swim, 90 km bike, and 21.1 km run.

marathon.title: Sub-3 Hour Marathon
marathon.description: Finished a full marathon in under 3 hours (2:56:09), an achievement that places me in the top percentile of marathon runners worldwide.

podiums.title: Multiple Podiums
podiums.description: Achieved numerous top-3 finishes in local and regional running events across various distances.

personalBests.title: Personal Best Racing Times
personalBests.quote: Each personal record represents countless hours of training, discipline, and determination. I bring this same dedication to helping my clients achieve their fitness goals.

testimonials.title: Client
testimonials.subtitle: See what some of my clients have to say about their training experience.

murilloWelsi.text: The strength training with Edgar has helped me reduce pain and avoid minor injuries. I feel more stable and am running better day-to-day.
